business_problem: At the beginning of the health emergency, pensioners were unable to apply for credit without being exposed to biological risk.
solution_summary: The Colombian company developed a solution that enables automating digital invoicing. Thanks to the scalability and security of Azure, DiBanka today offers optimization and efficiency in credit processes. At the beginning of the health emergency, pensioners were unable to apply for credit without being exposed to biological risk. DiBanka is a technology company that develops IT solutions for financial well-being, connecting non-financial, public and private organizations, invoice operators and collaborators and/or pensioners through a digital ecosystem. As a single solution for the entire process, DiBanka dramatically streamlines and automates the invoice. The implementation centers on Azure to support document processing workflows.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the underlying cloud infrastructure, identity, and managed services for the solution.

business_outcome: The invoicing credit in Colombia involves three actors: the affiliate, the payment agency and the invoicing operators. The DiBanka solution serves as an intermediary to this process, providing direct benefits to all parties involved.
